name: seq
note: shell scrollback: 5000 lines on the normal screen, scrolled back

name: vim
note: vim on a big file, scrolled down from the top; the lines differ in length so a scrolled frame can be told from the one before
command: awk 'BEGIN { for (i = 1; i <= 20000; i++) printf "line %d %s\n", i, substr("of a big file whose lines differ in length so a scrolled frame can be told apart", 1, i * 37 % 60 + 4) }' > /tmp/scroll-bench.txt && vim -n -u NONE -c 'set mouse=a' /tmp/scroll-bench.txt

name: nvim
command: awk 'BEGIN { for (i = 1; i <= 20000; i++) printf "line %d %s\n", i, substr("of a big file whose lines differ in length so a scrolled frame can be told apart", 1, i * 37 % 60 + 4) }' > /tmp/scroll-bench.txt && nvim -n --clean /tmp/scroll-bench.txt
